validity.recommendation: keep P0220 as the MVP MAINLINE row; it is NOT a duplicate of P4456
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE + CLASSIFICATION + DUPLICATE audit. P0220 exists and is correctly classified. IDENTITY: P0220 is the Mountain Valley Pipeline MAINLINE - the 303-mile, 42-inch greenfield interstate transmission line from Wetzel County, West Virginia (MP 0.0, at Equitrans' H-302 near MarkWest's Mobley plant) to Transco's Zone 5 Compressor Station 165 in Pittsylvania County, Virginia (MP 303.5), 2,000 MMcf/d, FERC Docket CP16-10, certificated 2017-10-13, in service 2024-06-11. Discriminators used, all from the sheet's own cells: blank SegmentName (the parent/mainline row), LengthKnown 303.00 mi, Diameter 42 in, Capacity 2000 MMcf/d, StartYear1 2024 / StartMonth1 6, SegmentCost $7.85B, and the Wetzel->Pittsylvania endpoint pair. It is NOT the Southgate extension (that is 31 mi, 30 in, 550 MMcf/d, VA->NC, in construction for 2028 - a separate tracker row), NOT a compression/expansion phase, and NOT a loop. DUPLICATE RULING vs P4456: NO DUPLICATE. P4456 carries SegmentName 'Greene Interconnect Project', LengthKnown 0.00 mi, Capacity 1000 MMcf/d, SegmentCost $28,000,000, RouteType 'Capacity expansion only', RouteAccuracy 'no route', and every location cell blank. In the EIA Aug 2026 workbook the two are separate rows with separate federal dockets: Excel row 1111 'Mountain Valley Pipeline', docket CP16-10, 303.5 mi, 42 in, 2000 MMcf/d, $6,600M, completed 2024-06-11; Excel row 1112 'Greene Interconnect Project', docket CP19-477, $28M, completed 2024-06-14. Greene Interconnect is a zero-new-pipe interconnect that moves up to 1 Bcf/d off MVP into Columbia Gas Transmission's KA System - it is downstream of and dependent on P0220, not the same asset. The shared tracker name 'Mountain Valley Gas Pipeline (MVP)' is a naming collision, not an entity collision; the fix (if GEM wants one) is to give P0220 an explicit SegmentName such as 'MVP Mainline', NOT to merge the rows. I made no edit of any kind to P4456.
